findings.body: Verified that legacy bias-gradient and dynamic activation range fields are successfully rejected at boundaries by CLI materialize-support-artifact and artifact validators, and that the burn-grad-smoke JSON artifact matches the corrected schema contract.

summary: The F-S7 bead bd-17n0 is verified as PASS at git HEAD c9b22033f08332153e733c3b8423de6d7e365de8. The closure claims and H8 invariants are perfectly supported by the current code, schemas, and test results. By correcting the F-S7 H8 `s7_burn_grad_smoke.v1` schema to match the bias-free, fixed-activation-range `ExpertBlockQat` model contract, the bead successfully prevents fabrication of unsupported projection-bias or learned activation-range gradients. All 11 `burn_expert` QAT tests, the activation range rejection test, the CLI field rejection tests, schema discipline validations, preregistration verification, and `verify-packet --substrate-only` checks pass cleanly with no remaining open findings.
